title: Board, score and freshness client components
description:
As a reader, I want a fast board that tells me how fresh its numbers are, so that I trust what I see.

Standard components: ranked board (sortable table from snapshot JSON), score readout (5-segment meter, value, n; grey when below a threshold), vote control (part of the votes plugin), "updated N min ago" label. Content that matters to search engines and agents is rendered as text; the user's own vote updates optimistically.

```gherkin
Feature: Board components
  Scenario: Render from JSON
    Given a board JSON file
    Then the board component renders ranked rows with scores and counts

  Scenario: Freshness
    Then the component shows how long ago the snapshot was generated

  Scenario: Optimistic own vote
    When the signed-in reader votes
    Then the reader's own control updates at once, before the next snapshot
```
